synthetic_disclaimer: ALL fixtures below are SYNTHETIC, written for failure-mode testing. They are NOT benchmark answers, NOT verbatim CUAD/LegalBench clauses, and MUST NOT be treated as ground truth for any external benchmark.
purpose: Failure-mode probes for contract analysis: IP ownership, assignment, licensing, confidentiality, indemnification, limitation of liability, warranties, termination, data rights, AI training/data-use. Intended to exercise deterministic signals (entailment + contract-ownership.js) with zero live model calls.
provenance: synthetic fixtures authored for SallyIP; no CUAD/LegalBench verbatim text; CC-BY sources are NOT reproduced here

field_guide.expected_finding: human-readable expected outcome for the category question
field_guide.expected_signals: structured hints for a future harness (assigns_ip for IP categories; risk_level otherwise)
field_guide.failure_mode: which analyzer weakness this fixture probes

items.clause_text: Consultant hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest in all Inventions conceived during the engagement, including all patent rights therein.
items.expected_finding: Yes — present assignment of created IP to counterparty
items.failure_mode: baseline affirmative assignment (hereby assign + right title interest)
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: All Deliverables and associated Intellectual Property Rights shall vest solely in the Customer upon creation, as works made for hire to the fullest extent permitted by law.
items.expected_finding: Yes — vesting language transfers ownership on creation (work-made-for-hire synonym)
items.failure_mode: synonym trap: vest / deliverables / work-made-for-hire vs plain assign/IP (lexical entailment miss)
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Developer retains all right, title and interest in its Background Technology developed prior to this Agreement; no ownership in such Background Technology is transferred.
items.expected_finding: No — retention of pre-existing IP, no transfer to counterparty
items.failure_mode: retention antonym: retains + pre-existing + no transfer with shared IP vocabulary
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Employee agrees to assign and hereby assigns to Employer all future Inventions relating to the business, and waives any moral rights therein to the extent assignable by law.
items.expected_finding: Yes — present + future assignment of inventions to counterparty
items.failure_mode: future-inventions + moral-rights waiver breadth (flagClause RED-adjacent, ownership Yes)
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights hereunder without the prior written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.
items.expected_finding: No — anti-assignment consent gate; no IP ownership transfer
items.failure_mode: assignment-word ambiguity: agreement-assignment vs IP-ownership assignment
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: The parties shall in good faith discuss and agree upon allocation of jointly developed intellectual property within 60 days after disclosure; no allocation is made by this clause alone.
items.expected_finding: No — agree-to-agree; ownership deferred to future negotiation, no present transfer
items.failure_mode: agree-to-agree trap: negotiate/discuss with IP vocabulary but no vesting or assignment
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Software solely for internal business purposes.
items.expected_finding: No assignment — license only (non-exclusive); must not be classified as IP assignment
items.failure_mode: assign-vs-license distinction: grant of license with no assign/vest/transfer verb
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Owner grants Distributor an exclusive license to exploit the Licensed Patents in the Territory, with Owner expressly retaining title to the Patents.
items.expected_finding: No assignment — exclusive license is still a license; title retained by owner
items.failure_mode: exclusive-license trap: exclusive != assignment when title is retained
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Contributor grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, reproduce and distribute the Contributions, without transferring ownership.
items.expected_finding: No assignment — broad perpetual license still transfers no ownership
items.failure_mode: breadth trap: perpetual/irrevocable license language mimics assignment scope but ownership stays
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential for three years following disclosure and use it only to perform this Agreement.
items.expected_finding: green — balanced mutual confidentiality with bounded term and purpose limit
items.failure_mode: clean baseline: bounded term should not false-positive as high-risk
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Recipient shall hold all of Disclosing Party's information in strict confidence in perpetuity and shall not use any residual knowledge retained in memory for any purpose.
items.expected_finding: amber — negotiable: perpetual duration with no residual-knowledge carve-out
items.failure_mode: duration trap: perpetuity without standard exclusions (flagClause RED-adjacent perpetual+irrevocable pattern)
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: All information disclosed in any form, whether marked confidential or not, is deemed Confidential, with no exclusions for public, known, or independently developed information.
items.expected_finding: red — overbroad definition with no standard carve-outs
items.failure_mode: overbreadth: missing public-domain/independent-development exclusions
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Each party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims arising from its gross negligence or willful misconduct, subject to the liability cap in Section 9.
items.expected_finding: amber — mutual fault-based indemnity with cap; negotiable but standard shape
items.failure_mode: baseline indemnity: mutual + capped should not read as uncapped red
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Vendor shall indemnify Customer without limitation against all intellectual property infringement claims, including all attorneys' fees and costs, at Vendor's sole expense.
items.expected_finding: red — uncapped one-way IP indemnity with fees
items.failure_mode: uncapped indemnity: without limitation + fees (flagClause RED-adjacent unlimited-indemnity pattern)
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Customer shall indemnify Provider against any claim that Provider's own technology infringes third-party intellectual property rights.
items.expected_finding: red — reverse indemnity: customer underwrites vendor's IP risk
items.failure_mode: direction trap: indemnity running the wrong way for IP risk
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Neither party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall exceed the amounts paid by Customer in the 12 months preceding the claim.
items.expected_finding: green — standard mutual cap tied to fees paid
items.failure_mode: clean cap baseline: bounded aggregate cap should read green
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Service Provider's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited in all respects.
items.expected_finding: red — uncapped liability
items.failure_mode: unlimited-liability keyword (flagClause RED pattern) must fire
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: The liability cap shall not apply to indemnification, confidentiality, intellectual property infringement, data breach, or non-payment obligations.
items.expected_finding: amber — illusory cap: carve-outs swallow most realistic loss scenarios
items.failure_mode: carve-out trap: nominal cap defeated by broad exclusions
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Provider warrants the Services will conform to the Documentation for 90 days after delivery; Customer's exclusive remedy for breach is re-performance of the affected Services.
items.expected_finding: green — bounded conformance warranty with exclusive remedy
items.failure_mode: clean warranty baseline: time-bounded + exclusive remedy
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS AGREEMENT, ALL WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, ARE DISCLAIMED.
items.expected_finding: amber — blanket disclaimer of implied warranties; negotiable allocation
items.failure_mode: disclaimer detection: implied-warranty disclaimer should surface, not read green
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Vendor warrants the Deliverables will be error-free and fit for any purpose Customer may contemplate, in perpetuity.
items.expected_finding: red — unachievable warranty: error-free plus unbounded fitness and duration
items.failure_mode: absolute-warranty trap: error-free + any-purpose + perpetuity
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 30 days' prior written notice to the other party.
items.expected_finding: amber — termination for convenience; negotiable exit right
items.failure_mode: convenience termination (flagClause AMBER pattern) must surface
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Provider may terminate this Agreement at any time without notice, and the Agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month terms unless Customer gives 90 days' advance notice of non-renewal.
items.expected_finding: amber — one-sided termination plus auto-renewal trap
items.failure_mode: one-sided exit + auto-renew: unilateral/without-notice/auto-renew cluster
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Either party may terminate for material breach if the breach remains uncured 30 days after written notice specifying the breach in reasonable detail.
items.expected_finding: green — balanced termination for cause with notice and cure
items.failure_mode: clean termination baseline: cause + cure should read green
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Customer retains ownership of all Customer Data; Processor shall process Customer Data only on documented instructions and shall return or delete it upon termination.
items.expected_finding: green — clean data allocation: ownership retained, processing bounded, return-or-delete
items.failure_mode: clean data baseline: instruction-bound processing should not flag
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Vendor may use, aggregate and commercialize all Customer Data, including personal data, for any business purpose without restriction or compensation.
items.expected_finding: red — overbroad data grab: unrestricted commercialization of customer data
items.failure_mode: data-grab trap: any-purpose commercialization without limits
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Vendor will take reasonable steps to protect Customer Data and will notify Customer of data breaches as appropriate, without a fixed timeline.
items.expected_finding: amber — vague security and breach-notice commitment with no timeline
items.failure_mode: vagueness trap: reasonable-steps / as-appropriate with no measurable duty
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Provider shall not use Customer Inputs or Outputs to train, retrain or improve any models and shall not retain such data beyond what is necessary to provide the Services.
items.expected_finding: green — protective no-training commitment with retention limit
items.failure_mode: clean AI baseline: explicit no-train + no-retain should read green
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Customer grants Provider a perpetual right to use all Inputs and Outputs to develop, train and improve machine-learning models, without compensation, notice, or opt-out.
items.expected_finding: red — broad training grab: perpetual model-training rights with no opt-out
items.failure_mode: training-grab trap: perpetual train/improve rights buried in data-use grant
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer

items.clause_text: Provider may use de-identified service data to improve its services, without defining de-identification, improvement scope, or whether model training is included.
items.expected_finding: amber — ambiguous improvement language: undefined de-identification and training scope
items.failure_mode: ambiguity trap: de-identified/improve without scope; possible training by another name
items.provenance: synthetic fixture; not a benchmark answer
